what: Monte Carlo Simulations for REDD+ uncertainty analysis (mocaredd) is a free and opensource application that aims at making simulation-based uncertainty calculations for REDD+ easier to process, report and verify.

what: Calculate emissions and IPCC Tier 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean2
title: Calculate emissions and IPCC Tier 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean2
text: Analytical counterpart fct_arithmetic_mean(). Instead Monte Carlo simulations, activity data emission factors aggregated deterministically uncertainty propagated IPCC Tier 1 (first-order error propagation) rules: relative uncertainties combine quadrature products absolute standard errors combine quadrature sums / differences. propagation done numerically independent input variables (carbon pool values, carbon fraction, degradation ratios activity data), correlations introduced shared inputs (e.g. degraded land use reuses intact carbon stock, global carbon fraction) handled consistently. result reports, reference / monitoring emission level emission reduction, mean, standard error, half-width uncertainty \(U\% = z \cdot se / |mean| \cdot 100\), \(z\) two-sided normal quantile setup$conf_level.

what: Calculate emissions and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean3
title: Calculate emissions and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty from arithmetic means — fct_arithmetic_mean3
text: Deterministic counterpart Monte Carlo chain (fct_combine_mcs_E(), fct_combine_mcs_P(), fct_combine_mcs_ER()), following steps means instead simulations, propagating uncertainty IPCC Approach 1 rules (IPCC 2006, Vol. 1, Ch. 3, Eq. 3.1 3.2): product: relative standard errors combine quadrature, \(U_{b} = \sqrt{U_a^2 + U_b^2}\); sum / difference: absolute standard errors combine quadrature, \(se_{+ b} = \sqrt{se_a^2 + se_b^2}\). Calculation chain: Carbon stock land use fct_make_formula2(). Composite factors resolved first: (1 + RS) (AGB + BGB). product rule within term, sum rule across terms. Degraded land uses: DG_ratio * C_intact (product rule), plus pools excluded degradation dg_pool "". Emission factors: EF = (C_i - C_f) * 44/12 (sum rule). intact degraded transitions EF = (1 - DG_ratio) * C_intact * 44/12 (product rule), intact stock counted twice. Emissions: E = AD * EF (product rule), annualised fct_combine_mcs_E(). Emissions per time period REDD+ activity (sum rule). Reference monitoring levels: length-weighted mean annual emissions time periods (sum rule). Emission reductions: ER = FREL - E_MON (sum rule). Approach 1 assumes combined terms independent. Correlations shared inputs (carbon fraction, carbon stock used several transitions, emission factors reference monitoring periods) ignored; Monte Carlo simulations (Approach 2) account .

what: Carbon stock formulas and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty per land use — fct_cstock_formula2
title: Carbon stock formulas and IPCC Approach 1 uncertainty per land use — fct_cstock_formula2
text: Builds, period land use carbon table, carbon stock formula variance relative uncertainty formulas (IPCC 2006, Vol. 1, Ch. 3, Eq. 3.1 3.2).
code: Each stock is written as \code{C = CF * S_DM + S_C}, with          \code{S_DM} the sum of pools in dry matter and \code{S_C} the sum          of pools in carbon. CF is factored once, so its uncertainty is          not counted as independent across pools:           \code{Var(C) = CF^2 * V_DM + (CF * CF_U * S_DM)^2 + V_C}           with \code{V_S = sum((X * X_U)^2)} over the pools of \code{S}.          With RS, AGB becomes \code{AGB * (1 + RS)} with variance          \code{(AGB * (1 + RS) * AGB_U)^2 + (AGB * RS * RS_U)^2}, and BGB is          ignored. If \code{ALL} is given, it replaces the other pools.           \code{c_tot_U = sqrt(Var(C)) / C}, simplified with the product          rule when the stock is a product (one pool, or DM pools only),          e.g. \code{sqrt(AGB_U^2 + (RS / (1 + RS) * RS_U)^2 + CF_U^2)}.           Evaluate with each element and its relative uncertainty as          \code{<element>} and \code{<element>_U} (se / mean). Land uses          without pools (e.g. DG_ratio only) return NA.

title: Make the carbon stock uncertainty formula of a land use (IPCC Approach 1) — fct_make_formula_U
text: Companion fct_make_formula2(): inputs, returns formula standard error carbon stock, built terms fct_make_formula2() IPCC Approach 1 rules (IPCC 2006, Vol. 1, Ch. 3, Eq. 3.1 3.2): - product: x * y * sqrt((x_se / x)^2 + (y_se / y)^2), - sum: sqrt(x_se^2 + y_se^2).
code: Composite factors are resolved first:          - \code{(1 + RS)}: standard error \code{RS_se},          - \code{(AGB + BGB)}: standard error \code{sqrt(AGB_se^2 + BGB_se^2)}.           Evaluate it with each element and its standard error as          \code{<element>} and \code{<element>_se} (e.g. \code{AGB}, \code{AGB_se},          \code{CF}, \code{CF_se}). Terms are assumed independent. A factor          equal to 0 in a product returns NaN.

what: Sensitivity analysis of REDD+ emissions and emission reductions (delta method) — fct_sensitivity2
title: Sensitivity analysis of REDD+ emissions and emission reductions (delta method) — fct_sensitivity2
text: Sensitivity reference level, monitoring emissions emission reductions independent model inputs (activity data, carbon elements, carbon fraction, degradation ratios), model Monte Carlo chain (fct_combine_mcs_E(), fct_combine_mcs_P(), fct_combine_mcs_ER()): carbon elements shared transitions land use, EF = C_i - C_f. Delta method: independent inputs first-order expansion, \(Var(Y) \approx \sum_i (\partial Y / \partial X_i)^2 \sigma_i^2\). share \((\partial Y / \partial X_i \cdot \sigma_i)^2 / Var(Y)\) first-order Sobol index input \(\). Shares summed input group, input type: activity data (AD) vs emission factors (EF: carbon stocks, carbon fraction, degradation ratios). AD x EF interaction second order included. AD tornado swings AD source across \(mean \pm z \cdot se\), inputs mean. Outputs linear AD, swing exact AD shares add AD group share.
